protocol.scope: Matched comparison on 16 previously exposed complete clips; not a fresh independent test.
protocol.labels: Mendeley whole-clip source labels, not verified fault-level or expert labels. AI01 annotations are not used.
protocol.baseline: Existing summarize_for_exercise(..., calibrated=False) on all shared temporal records.
protocol.final: Unmodified ExerciseSession.add/assess; initial idle exclusion and quality gates retained.
protocol.shared_processing: One tracked VIDEO pose pass per clip, enhanced=True, GUI temporal path with dt_seconds=1/media_fps and analyzer nominal FPS 30.
protocol.stopping: Decode full clip; no target-based truncation, countdown, preview, or recording. Does not validate automatic stopping or webcam speed.
protocol.mapping: Guided good -> correct; bad -> incorrect; unassessable retained.
protocol.metrics: Accuracy on all clips; binary macro-F1 with abstentions as false negatives; coverage; assessed-only accuracy; per-class precision/recall/F1; confusion matrix.
protocol.counts: Observed guided counts only. No manual rep references, so no count MAE or count-accuracy claim.
protocol.tuning: No threshold fitting, calibration profile loading, or post-result selection. Preserve all outputs, including failures.
